en.title: Airport transfers
en.intro: Private transfers to and from London’s airports and major private aviation terminals.
en.body:
Begin or end your visit with a private transfer between the airport and your chosen destination. We arrange journeys to and from Heathrow, Gatwick, Stansted, Luton, London City and Southend for private guests, families and business travellers.

Choose an executive saloon for a smaller party or discuss a passenger vehicle for your group. When planning the journey, tell us your flight details, collection point, destination and the number of people travelling, together with any luggage or accessibility requirements.

Private meet-and-greet and airport concierge arrangements are available on request. Our team will discuss the service details with you before your transfer is confirmed.
en.meta_description: Private transfers to and from London’s airports and major private aviation terminals.
en.image_alt: Black executive saloon with an aircraft at sunset, airport-transfer illustration.

it.title: Trasferimenti aeroportuali
it.intro: Trasferimenti privati da e per gli aeroporti di Londra e i principali terminal di aviazione privata.
it.body:
Inizia o concludi il tuo soggiorno con un transfer privato tra l’aeroporto e la destinazione scelta. Organizziamo viaggi da e per Heathrow, Gatwick, Stansted, Luton, London City e Southend per ospiti privati, famiglie e viaggiatori d’affari.

Scegli una berlina executive per un piccolo gruppo o valuta con noi un veicolo passeggeri. Per organizzare il viaggio, comunica i dettagli del volo, il punto di incontro, la destinazione e il numero di persone, insieme alle esigenze relative a bagagli e accessibilità.

Meet-and-greet privato e servizi di concierge aeroportuale sono disponibili su richiesta. Il nostro team concorderà con te i dettagli prima della conferma del transfer.
it.meta_description: Trasferimenti privati da e per gli aeroporti di Londra e i principali terminal di aviazione privata.

es.title: Traslados aeroportuarios
es.intro: Traslados privados desde y hacia los aeropuertos de Londres y las principales terminales de aviación privada.
es.body:
Comience o termine su estancia con un traslado privado entre el aeropuerto y su destino. Organizamos viajes desde y hacia Heathrow, Gatwick, Stansted, Luton, London City y Southend para clientes particulares, familias y viajeros de negocios.

Elija una berlina ejecutiva para un grupo pequeño o consulte sobre un vehículo de pasajeros. Para planificar el viaje, indique los datos del vuelo, el punto de recogida, el destino y el número de personas, además del equipaje y los requisitos de accesibilidad.

Los servicios privados de bienvenida y asistencia aeroportuaria están disponibles bajo petición. Nuestro equipo acordará los detalles con usted antes de confirmar el traslado.

en.title: Private transfers
en.intro: Tailored journeys to destinations in London and throughout the United Kingdom.
en.body:
A private transfer gives your journey a clear beginning and a destination of your choice. Travel between hotels, homes, business addresses and other destinations in London, or arrange a journey further afield in the United Kingdom.

Our professional drivers and Mercedes-Benz vehicle categories serve individuals, couples, families and groups. The arrangements are discussed personally, so your route, party size and travel requirements can be considered together.

Contact us about the collection and destination you have in mind. Let us know about your luggage, any planned stops and any individual requirements so that we can discuss a suitable vehicle and the details of your transfer.

I nostri autisti professionali e le categorie di veicoli Mercedes-Benz sono pensati per singoli viaggiatori, coppie, famiglie e gruppi. Gli accordi vengono discussi personalmente, valutando insieme percorso, numero di passeggeri ed esigenze di viaggio.

Contattaci per il punto di partenza e la destinazione desiderati. Comunica bagagli, eventuali soste ed esigenze individuali, così da parlare del veicolo adatto e dei dettagli del transfer.

en.intro: Explore London and the United Kingdom with a private itinerary shaped around your interests.
en.body:
See London through the places that interest you, or discover destinations beyond the capital on a private itinerary. Our tours bring a professional driver and an executive vehicle together with a programme shaped around your time and preferences.

Explore the city’s landmarks and neighbourhoods, from Westminster and Tower Bridge to Kensington, Covent Garden and Notting Hill. For a journey beyond London, discuss destinations such as Windsor, Oxford, Bath, Stonehenge and the Cotswolds.

Talk to us about the places you would like to visit and the pace that suits your party. Professional guiding in Italian is available on request; guiding and any individual visit arrangements are discussed separately with our team.

en.intro: A professional chauffeur at your disposal by the hour, for meetings, events and private journeys.
en.body:

Discuss a single engagement or a programme of meetings, visits and planned stops. We will talk through the itinerary, the people travelling and your preferred vehicle category so that the transport can be arranged around your requirements.

Professionalism, punctuality and discretion are central to our approach. Contact our team about your schedule, the duration you have in mind and any individual requirements. Service details and the fare are agreed directly before confirmation.

Professionalità, puntualità e discrezione sono al centro del nostro approccio. Contatta il team per orari, durata desiderata ed esigenze individuali. Dettagli del servizio e tariffa vengono concordati prima della conferma.

1. Our business and services
Londra Transfers Limited provides private chauffeur and ground-transport services in London and across the United Kingdom. The business is identified as follows: Londra Transfers Limited, incorporated in England and Wales under company number 14856485. Registered office: Regus, Cowork Desk 130, 6 to 9 Stockley Park, Uxbridge, UB11 1FW, England. Telephone / WhatsApp: +44 7438 700287. Email: info@londratransfers.co.uk. We describe airport and private-aviation ground transfers, private journeys, chauffeur hire, tailored tours, business and event transport, diplomatic/delegation transport and cruise-port transfers. Certain concierge and professional guiding services are available only on request and are subject to individual confirmation. A named airport, hotel or third party on this website does not by itself establish a formal partnership.

2. Website enquiries
The website allows you to request contact from our team. Submitting your name, email address and telephone number does not reserve a vehicle, establish availability, fix a fare or form a transport contract. No payment is collected by the website. An automated acknowledgement confirms receipt of an enquiry only.

3. Arranging and confirming a journey
After receiving your enquiry, we may contact you to understand the proposed journey, guest numbers, luggage, accessibility needs and any other relevant details. We will communicate available arrangements and any applicable price and conditions separately. A journey is confirmed only when Londra Transfers expressly accepts the arrangements and communicates a confirmation to you. The particular conditions agreed for that journey will form part of your contract with us.

4. Accurate journey information
Please provide accurate collection and destination details, travel dates and times, contact information, guest numbers and any special requirements when discussing a journey. Let us know promptly if those details change. You should allow appropriate time for airport check-in, connections, security procedures and other time-sensitive commitments. We will discuss material requirements with you before confirming the service.

5. Vehicles and service arrangements
Vehicle descriptions and images show the categories offered; they do not represent a guarantee of a particular registration, specification or individual vehicle. The agreed vehicle category, guest capacity and any essential accessibility, luggage or child-seat arrangements should be confirmed before travel. We will not treat a change affecting a material agreed requirement as automatically accepted without speaking with you.

6. Prices, payment and additional arrangements
The website does not display an automatic price quotation and does not process payments. The applicable fare, payment method and timing, and any agreed parking, waiting, toll, extra-stop, concierge or guiding charges are communicated separately before a journey is confirmed. No additional service is presumed to be included merely because it appears on the website.

7. Changes, cancellations and refunds
An enquiry through this website may be withdrawn without a booking-cancellation fee. After a journey has been expressly accepted, we will explain any cancellation or amendment terms before confirmation, along with the fare and payment terms. Any cancellation charge, including any deposit retained, must be reasonable, transparent and limited to genuine direct loss that cannot reasonably be avoided or recovered; it must not duplicate another charge for the same loss. No undisclosed fixed-percentage, full-fare, waiting or no-show penalty applies merely because this website is used. These terms do not limit applicable statutory rights, including where we cancel or fail to perform a confirmed service.

8. Delays and circumstances beyond reasonable control
London and UK journeys may be affected by traffic, road restrictions, weather, airport procedures or other events beyond our reasonable control. We will act with reasonable care and skill and communicate significant known changes where practicable. Flight monitoring, included waiting time and any treatment of missed pickups are matters to confirm when arranging each journey; the website does not promise a fixed allowance.

9. Safety, consideration and accessibility
Guests must comply with applicable safety laws and reasonable instructions designed to protect people and property. Please tell us of child-seat, mobility, wheelchair or assistance-animal requirements before travel so suitable arrangements can be discussed. We respect the rights of disabled guests and the applicable legal duties relating to reasonable adjustments and assistance dogs.

10. Our responsibility and your rights
We aim to provide services with reasonable care and skill. Nothing in these terms excludes or restricts liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, fraud, or any other liability that cannot lawfully be excluded. Any contractual remedy, limitation or allocation of responsibility remains subject to applicable law and the circumstances of the confirmed service. Your statutory consumer rights are not affected.

11. Complaints and communications
If you have a concern about an enquiry or journey, contact info@londratransfers.co.uk or +44 7438 700287 and provide enough information for us to investigate. We will review your concern and respond as appropriate. Personal information is handled as explained in our Privacy Notice. You can also contact the appropriate regulator or consumer-advice service where applicable.

12. Updates and applicable law
We may update the website and these terms for future enquiries and arrangements. A change posted after a journey has been confirmed does not automatically change the conditions already agreed for that journey. These terms are governed by the law of England and Wales, subject to any mandatory consumer protections and jurisdictional rights that apply to you.

Una richiesta inviata tramite il sito può essere ritirata senza penali di cancellazione della prenotazione. Gli ospiti devono rispettare la normativa sulla sicurezza e le ragionevoli indicazioni volte a tutelare persone e beni. Per segnalare un problema relativo a una richiesta o a un viaggio, scrivete a info@londratransfers.co.uk oppure chiamate il +44 7438 700287, indicando le informazioni utili alla verifica. Esamineremo la segnalazione e forniremo una risposta appropriata. I dati personali sono trattati secondo la nostra Informativa sulla privacy. Ove applicabile, potete anche rivolgervi all’autorità competente o ai servizi di consulenza per i consumatori.

Cuando aceptemos expresamente un trayecto, explicaremos antes de confirmarlo las condiciones de modificación y cancelación, junto con el precio y la forma de pago. Todo cargo o depósito retenido deberá ser razonable y transparente y limitarse a las pérdidas directas reales que no puedan evitarse o recuperarse razonablemente; no podrá duplicar importes cobrados por la misma pérdida. Utilizar esta web no supone aceptar penalizaciones no comunicadas, porcentajes fijos, el cobro automático de la tarifa completa, esperas o ausencias. Los derechos legales del consumidor permanecen intactos, incluidos los que correspondan si cancelamos o incumplimos un servicio confirmado.

8. Retrasos y circunstancias ajenas a nuestro control razonable
El tráfico, las restricciones de circulación, el tiempo, los procedimientos aeroportuarios y otros acontecimientos pueden afectar a los trayectos. Actuaremos con la diligencia y competencia razonables e informaremos, cuando resulte posible, de cambios importantes que conozcamos. El seguimiento de vuelos, el tiempo de espera incluido y la gestión de ausencias deben acordarse para cada servicio; esta web no promete un periodo fijo de espera.

9. Seguridad, consideración y accesibilidad
Los invitados deben respetar las leyes de seguridad y las instrucciones razonables destinadas a proteger a las personas y sus bienes. Comunique antes del viaje cualquier necesidad de sillas infantiles, movilidad, silla de ruedas o animales de asistencia para valorar las opciones adecuadas. Respetamos los derechos de las personas con discapacidad y las obligaciones legales sobre ajustes razonables y perros de asistencia.

10. Responsabilidad y derechos
Nos comprometemos a prestar los servicios con un cuidado y una competencia razonables. Estas condiciones no excluyen ni limitan la responsabilidad por fallecimiento o daños personales causados por negligencia, fraude o cualquier otra responsabilidad que la ley prohíba excluir. Las posibles soluciones y limitaciones contractuales están sujetas a la legislación aplicable y a las circunstancias del servicio confirmado. Sus derechos legales como consumidor no se ven afectados.

11. Reclamaciones y comunicaciones
Si tiene alguna incidencia con una consulta o un trayecto, escriba a info@londratransfers.co.uk o llame al +44 7438 700287, facilitando los datos necesarios para examinarla. Revisaremos su reclamación y responderemos según corresponda. El tratamiento de los datos personales se explica en nuestro Aviso de privacidad. También puede dirigirse a las autoridades o servicios de asesoramiento al consumidor competentes cuando proceda.

12. Actualizaciones y legislación aplicable
Podemos actualizar la web y estas condiciones para futuras consultas y contrataciones. Los cambios publicados después de la confirmación de un servicio no modifican automáticamente lo ya acordado. Las presentes condiciones se rigen por las leyes de Inglaterra y Gales, sin perjuicio de los derechos imperativos del consumidor y de las normas de competencia judicial que puedan aplicarse.

en.title: Privacy Notice
en.intro: This notice explains how Londra Transfers Limited collects and uses personal information when you contact us or enquire about private chauffeur transport.
en.body:
1. Who is responsible
The data controller is Londra Transfers Limited, incorporated in England and Wales under company number 14856485. Registered office: Regus, Cowork Desk 130, 6 to 9 Stockley Park, Uxbridge, UB11 1FW, England. Telephone / WhatsApp: +44 7438 700287. Email: info@londratransfers.co.uk. For privacy enquiries and requests about your information, please contact info@londratransfers.co.uk. This is a UK-based business offering private chauffeur and related ground-transport services.

2. Information you provide
The website enquiry forms collect your name, email address and telephone number, together with language, page or service context, submission time and necessary security information. They do not request subject, message, payment, bank, health or identity-document information. We may later retain correspondence needed to answer the enquiry and encrypted administrator follow-up notes. The online deletion-request form asks only for the enquiry email address and verifies access to that address.

3. Technical information and preferences
The website uses an HTTPS-protected first-party session cookie for application security, a first-party language-preference cookie, and local browser storage for the chosen light or dark theme. Hosting and security systems may record IP addresses, connection information and request logs under their own retention settings. Structured enquiry records do not deliberately store the original raw visitor IP as a customer field. Approximate country lookup uses a local DB-IP country database to choose a starting language at the neutral website address when automatic language selection is active. No visitor IP address is sent to DB-IP, and the country result is not stored in the enquiry record. A manual language choice takes precedence; explicit English, Italian and Spanish page URLs are not changed.

4. Why we use information and legal grounds
Where an individual requests information about a prospective service contract, responding and taking requested pre-contractual steps may rely on UK GDPR Article 6(1)(b) (and the corresponding EU GDPR provision if applicable). Handling enquiries submitted on behalf of another person or company, fraud prevention, reasonable service administration and complaint handling may rely on documented legitimate interests under Article 6(1)(f), balanced against individual rights. Processing required by law relies on Article 6(1)(c). Any separate marketing or optional non-essential tracking will require its own lawful basis and, where legally required, prior consent. These bases do not replace the additional Article 9 condition needed for special-category data.

5. What the website does not do
This website is an enquiry channel. It does not automatically confirm transport, generate fares, take payments or store payment-card details. It currently does not enable Google Analytics, advertising pixels or behavioural profiling. We do not use solely automated decisions with legal or similarly significant effects on customers as part of website enquiries, and we do not add enquirers automatically to a promotional mailing list.

6. Who may receive information
Personal data may be handled by the authorised administrator and by contracted service providers needed for website hosting (Hostinger), business email (Zoho), technical maintenance and security. When a transport service is later separately confirmed, relevant details may be provided to an appropriate driver or delivery partner. Regulators or other parties may receive data where the law requires it. Access should be limited, documented and governed by appropriate agreements; we do not sell personal data.

7. International processing
The business is based in the United Kingdom. Hosting, email and support services may involve processing or access from other countries. For information about the locations and safeguards relevant to the handling of your enquiry, contact info@londratransfers.co.uk. We do not describe all processing as taking place solely in the UK or the European Economic Area.

8. How long records are kept
For an enquiry that does not result in a confirmed journey, we apply a 180-calendar-day retention rule from the most recent substantive communication about that enquiry. Eligible expired website enquiry records are removed during the scheduled daily cleanup. A longer period may apply only while a particular enquiry remains genuinely active or where a documented legal obligation or an identifiable legal claim requires it; we regularly review such exceptions. Related messages, notes and attachments are subject to the same purpose-based review, while server logs and backups follow their justified operational schedules. Separately confirmed journeys may require different contractual or accounting records. You may request erasure sooner where applicable law gives you that right.

9. Security
Access to customer information is restricted to the authorised administrator. Selected enquiry and internal note fields are encrypted by the application; sessions, security controls and restricted access reduce risk. We use appropriate technical and organisational controls and review access and processor relationships. No system is guaranteed free from risk. If you believe information has been misused or disclosed, please contact info@londratransfers.co.uk.

10. Your data-protection rights
Subject to applicable law and the legal basis for processing, you may request access, correction, deletion or restriction, object to applicable processing, request portability where available and withdraw consent where we rely on consent. Use the data-deletion request page or contact info@londratransfers.co.uk for any privacy request. An administrator reviews deletion requests after proportionate identity verification; email verification is not an automatic decision to erase. We ordinarily respond within one calendar month, subject to lawful exceptions. You may complain to the ICO or the competent EEA supervisory authority where EU GDPR applies. Eligible enquiry records and related notes are erased following review. Relevant mailbox copies, downloads and exports must also be handled. Backup copies are put beyond normal use and expire under the documented backup schedule; they are not silently returned to use when a backup is restored. A limited administrative record of the outcome is retained without your enquiry contact details.

11. Complaints
Please contact us first at info@londratransfers.co.uk for privacy questions or complaints. You can also contact the UK Information Commissioner’s Office at ico.org.uk. If EU GDPR applies to the processing of your information, you may also be entitled to complain to the data-protection supervisory authority in an EU member state connected with your circumstances.

12. Children and special requirements
Our online forms are designed for adults arranging transport. Please do not send medical records, identification documents or sensitive personal information through general enquiry fields. If accessibility, assistance-animal, child-seat or similar requirements are material to a service, please share only the necessary details through the agreed secure communication channel. Special-category information must have an identified Article 9 condition and appropriate safeguards.

13. Changes and contact
We review this notice whenever personal-data practices change. If we introduce a new purpose or an optional service requiring consent, we will explain it and seek consent where required. For information requests, use the contact details in Section 1.

it.title: Informativa sulla privacy
it.intro: Questa informativa spiega come Londra Transfers Limited raccoglie e utilizza i dati personali quando ci contattate o richiedete servizi privati con conducente.
it.body:
1. Titolare del trattamento
Il titolare del trattamento è Londra Transfers Limited, società registrata in Inghilterra e Galles con numero 14856485. Sede legale: Regus, Cowork Desk 130, 6 to 9 Stockley Park, Uxbridge, UB11 1FW, Inghilterra. Telefono / WhatsApp: +44 7438 700287. Email: info@londratransfers.co.uk. Per richieste e diritti sulla privacy scrivete a info@londratransfers.co.uk. La società opera nel Regno Unito e offre servizi di trasporto privato con conducente. Questa informativa deve rispecchiare fornitori e misure effettivamente adottati.

2. Dati forniti direttamente
I moduli di richiesta del sito raccolgono nome, indirizzo email e telefono, insieme a lingua, pagina o servizio, data di invio e informazioni di sicurezza necessarie. Non richiedono oggetto, messaggio, pagamenti, dati bancari, sanitari o documenti di identità. Possiamo conservare successivamente la corrispondenza necessaria per rispondere e le note di gestione cifrate. Il modulo di cancellazione richiede soltanto l’indirizzo email usato per la richiesta e ne verifica l’accesso.

3. Informazioni tecniche e preferenze
Il sito utilizza un cookie di sessione di prima parte protetto da HTTPS per sicurezza e funzionamento, un cookie che ricorda la lingua e la memoria locale del browser per il tema chiaro o scuro. Hosting e sistemi di sicurezza possono trattare indirizzi IP e log secondo regole di conservazione proprie. I record delle richieste non sono progettati per archiviare l’IP originale come campo di contatto. Quando la selezione automatica della lingua iniziale è attiva all’indirizzo neutro del sito, il paese approssimativo viene individuato tramite un database locale DB-IP. Non inviamo l’indirizzo IP del visitatore a DB-IP e non conserviamo il risultato nel record della richiesta. La scelta manuale della lingua ha priorità; gli indirizzi delle pagine in inglese, italiano e spagnolo non vengono modificati.

4. Finalità e basi giuridiche
Per rispondere a richieste individuali e svolgere misure precontrattuali richieste può applicarsi l’art. 6, par. 1, lett. b), GDPR britannico e, ove pertinente, GDPR UE. La gestione di contatti aziendali o presentati per terzi, la prevenzione di abusi e la gestione dei reclami possono fondarsi su interessi legittimi documentati ai sensi della lett. f), dopo adeguato bilanciamento. Gli obblighi di legge ricadono nella lett. c). Marketing separato e tracciamento non necessario richiederanno l’apposita base giuridica e, quando imposto, consenso preventivo. Per eventuali categorie particolari di dati occorre inoltre una condizione dell’art. 9.

5. Funzioni non presenti sul sito
Il sito permette soltanto l’invio di richieste: non conferma automaticamente il trasporto, non genera tariffe, non riscuote pagamenti e non memorizza dati di carte. La configurazione attuale non abilita Google Analytics, pixel pubblicitari o profilazione comportamentale. Non utilizziamo decisioni esclusivamente automatizzate con effetti giuridici o analogamente significativi nelle richieste online e non iscriviamo automaticamente chi ci contatta a una lista promozionale.

6. Destinatari dei dati
I dati possono essere trattati dall’amministratore autorizzato e da fornitori contrattuali per hosting (Hostinger), posta aziendale (Zoho), manutenzione e sicurezza. Dopo la conferma separata di un viaggio, i dati pertinenti possono essere comunicati al conducente o al fornitore incaricato. Potranno essere comunicati alle autorità ove previsto dalla legge. Gli accessi devono essere limitati, documentati e coperti dagli accordi necessari; non vendiamo dati personali.

7. Trattamento internazionale
La società ha sede nel Regno Unito. I servizi di hosting, posta elettronica e assistenza possono comportare trattamento o accesso da altri Paesi. Per informazioni sulle ubicazioni e sulle garanzie pertinenti al trattamento della tua richiesta, contatta info@londratransfers.co.uk. Non descriviamo ogni trattamento come effettuato esclusivamente nel Regno Unito o nello Spazio economico europeo.

8. Periodo di conservazione
Per una richiesta che non porta a un viaggio confermato, applichiamo una regola di conservazione di 180 giorni di calendario dall’ultima comunicazione sostanziale relativa alla richiesta. I record scaduti che possono essere eliminati vengono cancellati durante la procedura giornaliera programmata. Un periodo maggiore può valere soltanto se la richiesta è effettivamente ancora attiva o quando un obbligo di legge documentato o una specifica controversia lo richieda; tali eccezioni sono riesaminate periodicamente. Messaggi, note e allegati sono soggetti alla stessa verifica della necessità, mentre log del server e copie di sicurezza seguono i rispettivi tempi operativi giustificati. Per i viaggi confermati possono valere diversi obblighi contrattuali o contabili. La cancellazione può essere richiesta prima quando la legge lo consente.

9. Sicurezza
L’accesso alle informazioni dei clienti è riservato all’amministratore autorizzato. Alcuni campi delle richieste e le note interne sono crittografati; sessioni e controlli riducono i rischi. Adottiamo misure tecniche e organizzative adeguate e rivediamo gli accessi e i rapporti con i fornitori. Nessun sistema elimina ogni rischio. Per segnalazioni scrivete a info@londratransfers.co.uk.

10. I vostri diritti
Nei limiti della normativa e della base giuridica, potete chiedere accesso, rettifica, cancellazione o limitazione, opporvi ai trattamenti applicabili, richiedere la portabilità ove prevista e revocare il consenso quando il trattamento si basa su di esso. Usate la pagina di richiesta di cancellazione oppure contattate info@londratransfers.co.uk per qualsiasi richiesta sulla privacy. Un amministratore esamina le richieste dopo una verifica proporzionata dell’identità; la verifica email non determina una cancellazione automatica. Di regola rispondiamo entro un mese di calendario, salve le eccezioni previste dalla legge. Potete reclamare all’ICO o all’autorità competente del SEE quando si applica il GDPR UE. Dopo la revisione cancelliamo i dati delle richieste eliminabili e le relative note. Devono essere gestite anche le copie nelle email, nei download e nelle esportazioni. Le copie di backup sono escluse dall’uso ordinario e scadono secondo la procedura documentata, senza essere reintrodotte durante un ripristino. Conserviamo un registro amministrativo limitato dell’esito, senza i recapiti della richiesta.

11. Reclami
Per domande o reclami sulla privacy contattate prima info@londratransfers.co.uk. Potete anche rivolgervi all’Information Commissioner’s Office britannico su ico.org.uk; se si applica il GDPR UE, potrebbe essere competente anche un’autorità di controllo di uno Stato membro.

12. Minori ed esigenze particolari
I moduli sono destinati ad adulti che organizzano il trasporto. Evitate di inviare cartelle cliniche, documenti d’identità o dati sensibili tramite il modulo generico. Quando esigenze di mobilità, assistenza, seggiolini o simili sono rilevanti, fornite soltanto le informazioni necessarie tramite il canale sicuro concordato. Eventuali dati particolari richiedono una condizione dell’art. 9 e misure adeguate.

13. Modifiche e contatti
Rivediamo l’informativa quando cambiano le modalità di trattamento. Nuove finalità, analisi non essenziali, hosting o accessi di fornitori diversi devono essere valutati e spiegati prima dell’attivazione, con consenso quando necessario. Per esercitare i diritti utilizzate i contatti indicati nella Sezione 1.

El responsable del tratamiento es Londra Transfers Limited, sociedad constituida en Inglaterra y Gales con número 14856485. Los formularios de consulta del sitio recogen nombre, correo electrónico y teléfono, junto con idioma, página o servicio, fecha de envío e información de seguridad necesaria. No solicitan asunto, mensaje, pagos, datos bancarios, médicos ni documentos de identidad. Posteriormente podremos conservar la correspondencia necesaria para responder y las notas de seguimiento cifradas. El formulario de supresión solo solicita la dirección de correo utilizada en la consulta y verifica el acceso a esa dirección.

3. Datos técnicos y preferencias
La web utiliza una cookie de sesión propia protegida por HTTPS para seguridad y funcionamiento, una cookie de idioma y almacenamiento local del navegador para el tema claro u oscuro. El alojamiento y la seguridad pueden tratar direcciones IP y registros con sus propios plazos. Los registros estructurados de consultas no están diseñados para almacenar la IP original como dato de contacto. Cuando la selección automática del idioma inicial está activa en la dirección neutra del sitio, el país aproximado se determina mediante una base de datos local DB-IP. No enviamos la dirección IP del visitante a DB-IP ni guardamos el resultado en el registro de la consulta. La elección manual del idioma tiene prioridad; las direcciones de las páginas en inglés, italiano y español no se modifican.

4. Finalidades y bases jurídicas
Para atender consultas individuales y adoptar medidas precontractuales solicitadas puede aplicarse el artículo 6.1.b) del RGPD británico y, cuando corresponda, del RGPD UE. La gestión de contactos empresariales o de solicitudes presentadas por terceros, la prevención de abusos y las reclamaciones podrán basarse en intereses legítimos documentados conforme al artículo 6.1.f), tras ponderar los derechos de las personas. Las obligaciones legales se fundamentan en el artículo 6.1.c). El marketing independiente y el seguimiento no necesario exigirán su propia base jurídica y, cuando proceda, consentimiento previo. Las categorías especiales necesitan además una condición del artículo 9.

5. Funciones que no ofrece la web
La web es un canal de consultas: no confirma viajes automáticamente, no calcula tarifas, no cobra pagos y no almacena tarjetas. La configuración actual no habilita Google Analytics, píxeles publicitarios ni perfiles de comportamiento. No adoptamos decisiones exclusivamente automatizadas con efectos legales o similares en las consultas web ni suscribimos automáticamente a quienes preguntan a comunicaciones promocionales.

6. Destinatarios
Los datos pueden ser tratados por el único administrador autorizado y proveedores contratados de alojamiento (Hostinger), correo empresarial (Zoho), mantenimiento y seguridad. Tras la confirmación independiente de un servicio, los detalles pertinentes pueden comunicarse al conductor o proveedor encargado. Podrán comunicarse a autoridades cuando lo exija la ley. Los accesos deben ser limitados, documentados y cubiertos por acuerdos adecuados; no vendemos datos personales.

7. Tratamiento internacional
La empresa está establecida en el Reino Unido. Los servicios de alojamiento, correo y soporte pueden implicar tratamiento o acceso desde otros países. Para información sobre las ubicaciones y salvaguardias pertinentes al tratamiento de su consulta, contacte con info@londratransfers.co.uk. No describimos todo el tratamiento como realizado exclusivamente en el Reino Unido o el Espacio Económico Europeo.

8. Conservación de datos
Para las consultas que no den lugar a un trayecto confirmado, aplicamos una regla de conservación de 180 días naturales desde la última comunicación sustantiva relativa a la consulta. Los registros caducados que puedan suprimirse se eliminan durante la limpieza diaria programada. Podrá aplicarse un plazo mayor únicamente si la consulta sigue realmente activa o lo exige una obligación legal documentada o una reclamación jurídica concreta; esas excepciones se revisan periódicamente. Los mensajes, notas y adjuntos están sujetos a la misma revisión de necesidad, mientras que los registros del servidor y las copias de seguridad siguen sus propios plazos operativos justificados. Los trayectos confirmados pueden requerir registros contractuales o contables con períodos distintos. Podrá solicitar la supresión antes cuando proceda legalmente.

9. Seguridad
El acceso a la información de los clientes está limitado al administrador autorizado. Ciertos campos de consulta y notas internas se cifran; las sesiones y controles de acceso reducen el riesgo. Aplicamos medidas técnicas y organizativas adecuadas y revisamos accesos y proveedores. Ningún sistema elimina todos los riesgos. Para informar de un problema escriba a info@londratransfers.co.uk.

10. Sus derechos
Según la ley y la base jurídica aplicables, puede solicitar acceso, rectificación, supresión o limitación, oponerse a los tratamientos correspondientes, pedir portabilidad cuando proceda y retirar el consentimiento cuando esa sea la base del tratamiento. Utilice la página de solicitud de supresión o contacte con info@londratransfers.co.uk para cualquier solicitud de privacidad. Un administrador revisa las solicitudes tras una verificación proporcionada de identidad; verificar el correo no implica una supresión automática. Normalmente respondemos dentro de un mes natural, salvo las excepciones legales. Puede reclamar ante la ICO o la autoridad competente del EEE cuando se aplique el RGPD de la UE. Tras la revisión se eliminan los registros de consultas que puedan suprimirse y sus notas. También deben gestionarse las copias en el correo, las descargas y las exportaciones. Las copias de seguridad se excluyen del uso habitual y caducan según el procedimiento documentado, sin reintroducirse al restaurar una copia. Conservamos un registro administrativo limitado del resultado, sin los datos de contacto de la consulta.

11. Reclamaciones
Para consultas o reclamaciones de privacidad contacte primero en info@londratransfers.co.uk. También puede acudir a la autoridad británica Information Commissioner’s Office (ico.org.uk); si se aplica el RGPD UE, podrá ser competente una autoridad supervisora de un Estado miembro.

12. Menores y requisitos especiales
Los formularios se dirigen a adultos que organizan transporte. No envíe historiales médicos, documentos de identidad ni datos sensibles mediante formularios generales. Cuando sean relevantes cuestiones de movilidad, animales de asistencia, sillas infantiles u otras necesidades, comunique solamente los detalles necesarios por el canal seguro acordado. Las categorías especiales exigen una condición del artículo 9 y salvaguardias adecuadas.

13. Cambios y contacto
Revisaremos este aviso cuando cambien las prácticas de tratamiento. Nuevos fines, análisis no esenciales, otro alojamiento o accesos de proveedores deben evaluarse y comunicarse antes de activarse, obteniendo consentimiento cuando sea necesario. Para ejercer sus derechos utilice los datos de la Sección 1.

en.body:
1. Scope
Londra Transfers Limited (company number 14856485) operates this website as a service-enquiry channel; it does not accept online payments or automatically confirm journeys. Registered office: Regus, Cowork Desk 130, 6 to 9 Stockley Park, Uxbridge, UB11 1FW, England. This policy concerns transport arrangements separately agreed with the company and is subject to mandatory consumer rights.

2. Before a journey is confirmed
Submitting, changing or withdrawing a website enquiry before Londra Transfers has expressly accepted a journey is free of booking-cancellation charges. A receipt acknowledgement does not constitute acceptance of a transport booking or a payment request.

3. How to request a change or cancellation
Contact us as soon as possible by telephone / WhatsApp on +44 7438 700287 or email at info@londratransfers.co.uk. Please identify the journey and the requested change. We will explain whether the journey has been confirmed and any arrangements already committed to before calculating an applicable charge.

4. Cancellation by the guest
Before a journey is agreed, we will explain any cancellation conditions and associated charges transparently. If a guest cancels a confirmed service, any retained payment or additional fee must be fair and correspond to genuinely incurred direct loss caused by the cancellation after reasonable steps to reduce that loss. We will account for costs avoided, alternative work obtained and amounts already received; we will not recover the same loss twice. We do not impose automatic full-fare charges, blanket non-refundable deposits or percentages merely for cancellation, and any charge remains subject to applicable consumer law.

5. Airport pickups, waiting and no-shows
Waiting periods, flight delays, late changes and no-show arrangements must be communicated as part of the particular journey confirmation. A no-show or additional waiting charge is not created merely by using this website.
